messages:
Maria Chen: Kicking off a focused Q3 runtime roadmap thread. We need to turn customer telemetry into a prioritized set of bets for kernels / quant / KV. I propose we decide on 2 primary initiatives + 1 experiment lane by next Wed.
Arjun Patel: +1. Can we frame this around 3 customer signals: p95 latency regressions, cost-per-1k-tokens, and cache hit rate by workload?
Samira Khan: I'm okay with that signal set. FYI recent enterprise customers care more about p99 tail than average p95. We should include tail latency SLOs for Dedicated.
Leo Park: Quick data point: last 30 days the embedding-heavy workloads show KV cache hit rates at ~22% and pushing batching higher reduces latency for those flows but increases mem pressure.
Tom Rivera: For kernel work — fusion buys ~10-15% throughput on our internal tests, but requires changes to operator scheduling. Quantization improvements (8-bit dynamic) bought ~22% cost savings on some LLMs with modest quality loss on instruction-following prompts.
Maria Chen: Good tradeoffs. We need to map those to customer impact. Which customers/segments move the revenue needle if we prioritize quant vs kernels vs KV?
Samira Khan: Enterprise X (search product) would see immediate cost savings from quant; Platform internal customers care more about predictable tail latency so kernels+prefetch helps them.
Arjun Patel: Suggest we define launch criteria per initiative: measurable KPI, canary plan, rollback threshold. Example: quant initiative KPI = 15% unit cost reduction on GPT-like 7B family with <2% quality delta on eval set.
Maria Chen: Yes. Draft launch criteria:
```
- Quant initiative: >=15% cost/unit on target models; eval regression <2% on core prompts; canary traffic on Dedicated pool at 5% for 48h, auto-rollback on >1.5x error rate or >8% p99 regression.
- Kernel fusion: >=10% throughput improvement for seq_len<=1024 workloads; no increase in memory peak >12%; canary in hosted for non-prod only then Dedicated pilot.
- KV prefetch/cache: hit rate uplift >=30% for embedding/recall workloads; tail latency improvement p99 <= -20ms; test with 3 pilot customers.
```
Leo Park: Minor nit: memory peak threshold should be absolute too (e.g., < 0.8GB extra per instance) so infra doesn't OOM on certain GPU types.
Tom Rivera: Also add quant fallback policy for hallucination/quality incidents: route to full-precision variant automatically for specific endpoints.
kpi-bot: Note: adding 'cost/unit' KPI requires aligning with finance tagging. Estimated lag 3 business days to get authoritative numbers.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: quant-v2 -> dedicated-us-west at 2024-07-12T02:00Z if owners approve.
Arjun Patel: Ops question: how much engineering effort do we estimate per initiative? Ballpark sprint months?
Samira Khan: Ballpark: quant improvements (2 engs, 3 sprints), kernel fusion (3–4 engs, 4–6 sprints), KV prefetch (2 engs backend + 1 infra, 3 sprints). These include canarying and rollback automation.
Maria Chen: OK — prioritization input: revenue impact (enterprise customers), SLO risk (if we don't act), cost savings, and cross-team effort. Please react with :one:/:two:/:three: for your preferred bet order (1-highest).
Leo Park: :one: kernels, :two: quant, :three: KV
Tom Rivera: :one: quant, :two: kernels, :three: KV
Arjun Patel: :one: quant, :two: KV, :three: kernels (ops wants tail improvements but cost matters for growth)
Samira Khan: :one: kernels, :two: KV, :three: quant (enterprise SLOs first)
Maria Chen: Tally so far leans split between quant and kernels. I'll run a quick customer impact scorecard and post by EOD tomorrow. Action items: 1) Arjun/Tom - draft launch criteria doc w/ rollback hooks (due in 48h). 2) Leo - compile telemetry slices for top 5 customers (due 72h). 3) Samira - surface enterprise SLOs and required audit trails (due 72h).
Tom Rivera: I'll draft canary playbook snippets and include the fallback JSON config. Example snippet:
```
{
  "route": "auto-fallback",
  "trigger": {
    "p99_latency_pct_change": 1.5,
    "error_rate_multiplier": 1.5
  },
  "fallback_target": "quant-v1->fp32"
}
```
Maria Chen: Perfect. Let's reconvene in the weekly runtime sync to finalize bets before roadmap freeze. Thanks all.
deploy-bot: Canary note: quant-v2 canary tentative, pending doc sign-off.
Arjun Patel: One more ask — product should price-test the cost wins so sales can talk savings to prospects. I'll loop in pricing after the scorecard.
Maria Chen: Good call. Closing thread for now — will post the scorecard + recommended top bet by tomorrow EOD.
